$comment: Nov. 6, 2026 Oklahoma-week issue: the eight live posts in reading order, plus the editorial rules prepare.py applies to each body. Nothing here is a live Wix object. Bodies come from GET /blog/v3/posts/{id}?fieldsets=URL&fieldsets=RICH_CONTENT (published version only), normalized by magazine/normalize_wix_post.py. Every rule below is reported in receipt.json. Wording is never rewritten: rules only drop web furniture, empty paragraphs, display byline lines, stray one-letter paragraphs and link-only text, move a credit into a caption (dropping a 'Cover:' label), split a paragraph at a literal newline, or pair a mismatched quote mark. Global rules (all posts): empty paragraphs are dropped and leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; both are counted per post in receipt.json. Order: 1 Best Fridays (leads, matches the supplied cover), 2 Thursday show recap, 3 Soothsayer, 4 Condon (men's gamer, kept prominent), 5 McMiller, 6 first CFP Top 25, 7 Golden Goose, 8 Yost.
